title: Dog Night, 2024
logline: Twenty-five years. The alley from directly above, gull's-eye: the dumpster's lid, two small figures — a man and a three-legged dog — and the sign's roofline with its dead tubes, rain making rings in a puddle. No caption.

panels.composition: Straight down into the alley at night: the dumpster's lid, a man's head and shoulders in a rain shell and a small three-legged dog beside him, the neon sign's roofline with most tubes dark, rain ringing a puddle. Tiny from above.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a straight-down view into a night alley with a dumpster's lid, the top of a man in a rain shell and a small three-legged dog beside him, a neon sign's roofline with most tubes dark, rain making rings in a puddle, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
